title: [The Dragon Macaw, A-Parrot-ly]
description: One entire wall of the cabin is comprised of a jade and wrought iron tree with dozens of spreading branches covered in lifelike mechanical parrots.  The rest of the cabin is awash with gadgets, gears, and mechanical doo-dads in various stages of assembly.  Behind a counter almost but not quite free of clutter, a burghal gnome sits tinkering with a bright green mithril parrot.
